name: puertosalguero.com.ar
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But other sites can frame the page.
lesson: Send frame-ancestors 'self' in the CSP, or X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, so other sites cannot frame your pages.
summary: www.puertosalguero.com.ar scores 67 out of 100 (D). 1 check fails now, 37 are at risk, and 38 pass. Fix first: tracking starts on load and no banner asks first.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw HubSpot (4 requests), Google Ads (1 request), and cookies __hstc, hubspotutk, __hssrc, __hssc, _gcl_au, bSession on instafeed.codev.wixapps.net.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 7 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: axios 0.21.4 has known flaws
fix.evidence: axios 0.21.4 (banner of /_partials/wix-thunderbolt/dist/clientWorker.1db1888f.bundle.min.js): 24 known flaws, the worst rated critical, such as CVE-2023-45857, CVE-2025-27152, CVE-2026-25639. Axios does not correctly normalize hostnames when checking…
fix.fix: Upgrade axios to 1.6.8 or later. A major upgrade changes behavior, so retest the pages that use it.

vars.name: axios
vars.summary: Axios does not correctly normalize hostnames when checking NO_PROXY rules, causing requests to loopback addresses with a trailing dot (loca….

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 7 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: HubSpot appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: Scripts fingerprint the browser on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, js.hs-analytics.net drew hidden text on a canvas and read it back, measured which fonts are installed, and rendered a silent audio tone. Read together, these give the browser an ID that survives clearing cookies.
fix.fix: Find the tag behind each host and hold it until consent, like a tracking cookie. If it is fraud or bot protection, name it in the privacy notice.
